Matt Robertson Wins Record $1.25 Million at Inaugural World Bass Enterprises Tournament

Record-Breaking Purse Awarded in Nashville

Matt Robertson of Kuttawa, Kentucky, secured a first-place finish at the inaugural World Bass Enterprises (WBE) "The Champions" tournament, taking home a payout of $1.25 million. According to the announcement, the event featured a total prize purse of $3.25 million, which the organizers reported as the largest monetary prize ever awarded to a winner in bass fishing history.

Top Finalists and Catch Details

The competition concluded at Old Hickory Lake at Sanders Ferry Park near Nashville, featuring a final-day showdown among the top 15 anglers from an initial field of 62 participants. The leading finishers reported by WBE include:

  • Matt Robertson (Kuttawa, Ky.): 1st place, $1.25 million (20 lbs. 2 oz catch, 5 fish)
  • Pake South (Winnsboro, Texas): 2nd place, $500,000 (13 lbs. 7 oz catch, 4 fish)
  • Wesley Strader (Spring City, Tenn.): 3rd place, $300,000 (11 lbs. 2 oz catch, 4 fish)
  • Trey McKinney (Carbondale, Ill.): 4th place, $200,000 (11 lbs. 0 oz catch, 5 fish)
  • Michael Neal (Dayton, Tenn.): 5th place, $100,000 (10 lbs. 10 oz catch, 5 fish)

Additionally, the team competition format divided the field into "Team Stripes" and "Team Stars," with Team Stars winning "The Champions Cup" during Friday's events.

Event Context and Entertainment

Established in 2026, WBE designed the tournament to bring together top competitors from organizations such as Major League Fishing's Bass Pro Tour. Alongside the fishing competition, the event incorporated entertainment elements, including opening ceremonies featuring NFL Hall of Fame wide receiver Randy Moss, angler Bill Dance, and Gerald Swindle. Musical acts featured performances by Riley Green, Randy Houser, Lee Greenwood, and Trace Adkins.

Practical Implications and Verification

Fans and industry observers seeking to review official final standings, verify complete participant lists, or check future organizational updates can access the official data directly through the World Bass Enterprises website at www.worldbassenterprises.com.
